purpose: Independent purpose-dependent acceptance authority for reduced hydrological models

required: Bound to a named hydrological purpose and quantity of interest
Spatial and temporal support stated or defensibly bounded
Error type identified: application consequence, numerical allocation, observational uncertainty, or structural/model-form error
No substitution of solver convergence, bookkeeping closure, achieved RMSE, or generic goodness-of-fit for application tolerance
authority_eligibility_rule.direction: external_or_purpose_requirement -> frozen acceptance semantics -> future blind candidate validation

accepted_repository_authorities.use: Preserves the no-candidate-exposure rule and the distinction between application tolerance, numerical closure, observation error, and achieved model error.

extracted_authority.quantity: groundwater head at the SWAP-groundwater coupling interface
extracted_authority.basis: 1% of the smallest 0.4 m prescribed groundwater-depth treatment separation; 25% of that allowance allocated prospectively to temporal discretisation

accepted_repository_authorities.boundary: Explicitly numerical prediction-error governance. It does not qualify model structural uncertainty, parameter uncertainty, forcing uncertainty, or a universal hydrological impact threshold.
The interface allocation is a numerical coupling budget, not a structural reduced-model error allowance and not a physical-impact threshold.

extracted_authority: One immutable accepted SWAP origin per coupling window
All correctors replay from that accepted origin
Coupled convergence is conjunctive: MODFLOW nonlinear convergence and interface-flux consistency are both required
Rejected SWAP candidates are discarded and cannot mutate accepted state
accepted_repository_authorities.boundary: The contract requires a q_tolerance but does not itself establish a hydrological application tolerance for reduced-model structural error.

extracted_authority: Accepted transfer is published exactly once after all participant preflights
Retry reconstructs from the last accepted timestep
Post-publication failure is durability/restart, not rollback-safe scientific retry
One prepared MODFLOW solve per window
All SWAP correctors originate from one accepted checkpoint
No participant publication before all preflights pass
One SWAP revision/time advance and one interface-ledger exchange commit
accepted_repository_authorities.boundary: Near-equilibrium restricted envelope; arbitrary prescribed-head jumps are not admitted.

accepted_repository_authorities.interpretation: The head budget is inherited from project governance. The flux criterion, hard mass tolerance, and iteration ceiling are execution/qualification controls and are not promoted to general hydrological application tolerances.
accepted_repository_authorities.state_memory_authority: F2 rebuilds each next-window predictor from the current committed SWAP state and the actual previously accepted interface state; rejected/intermediate correctors remain nonmutating and cumulative ledger exchange follows accepted windows.

accepted_external_or_product_authorities.title: Validatie en toetsing LHM 4.1, Deelrapport 2: Onverzadigde zone
accepted_external_or_product_authorities.publisher_context: HKV/Acacia Water/Berendrecht Consultancy in opdracht van Rijkswaterstaat
extracted_authority: National mean correlation between observed and calculated monthly soil moisture during the growing season must be at least 0.6.
Correlation must be at least 0.6 in each distinguished regional area type.
For field-sensor locations, monthly observed-calculated soil-moisture correlation during the growing season must be at least 0.6 for 80% of locations.
accepted_external_or_product_authorities.boundary: This is a monthly temporal-pattern criterion for LHM validation. It does not prescribe absolute volumetric-water-content error, depth-interval storage error, wetting/drying-front timing error, or profile-extreme fidelity.

accepted_external_or_product_authorities.title: Validatie en toetsing LHM 4.1, Deelrapport 1: Grondwater
accepted_external_or_product_authorities.publisher_context: HKV/Acacia Water/Berendrecht Consultancy in opdracht van Rijkswaterstaat
extracted_authority: For freatic groundwater recession during prolonged drought, the recession course may deviate by less than 25% in 80% of areas/measurement locations under the report's criterion.
Groundwater-head dynamics criteria are expressed as allowed deviation relative to measured dynamics, including 35% for the first aquifer and 50% for deeper head in the report text.
Timing of the lowest groundwater level was investigated but was not established as a current criterion.
accepted_external_or_product_authorities.boundary: These are downstream LHM groundwater validation endpoints. They do not directly define an allowable SWAP-MODFLOW interface-flux error or a Layer-ROM structural-error budget.

accepted_external_or_product_authorities.title: Rijkswaterstaat Publicatie Platform: Validatie en toetsing LHM 4.1
accepted_external_or_product_authorities.extracted_authority: Confirms LHM use for the National Water Model and drought insight and that the validation was performed for Rijkswaterstaat with user involvement.

examples: <10% recharge error from a case-specific estimability study
rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.reason: Numerical/accounting closure, case-specific achieved performance, remote-sensing product accuracy, or context-free model-fit guidance are not direct reduced-model application tolerances.

rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.rejected_candidate: Use 1e-15 m/s flux convergence or 1e-12 cm hard SWAP mass tolerance as Layer-ROM application error limits
rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.reason: These values are numerical execution and conservation controls. They do not state the permissible hydrological consequence of reduced-model structural approximation.

rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.rejected_candidate: Use 0.004 m total Stage 0 head budget or 0.001 m interface budget directly as Layer-ROM structural tolerance
rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.reason: The governing documents explicitly exclude model structural uncertainty. No independent allocation from the Stage 0 numerical budget to reduced-model structural error exists.

rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.rejected_candidate: Use correlation >=0.6 as an absolute profile/storage/front-timing tolerance
rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.reason: Correlation constrains temporal association at the report's support. It does not bound absolute state error, vertical redistribution, front timing, extrema, or per-layer storage bias.

rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.rejected_candidate: Back-convert LHM groundwater recession/dynamics criteria to one portable exchange-flux tolerance without an independently governed response mapping
rejected_or_nontransferable_authorities.reason: The flux-to-head/recession mapping is system-, state-, and timescale-dependent; no portable authorized inversion is established here.

source_review_decision: NEW_PARTIAL_AUTHORITY_FOUND_AFTER_APP0: bounded GW-D consequence/numerical governance and formal LHM downstream/product criteria exist, but no direct independent Layer-ROM structural-error tolerance is established for GW-R, GW-D, or the requested SCI-P profile vector.
